notes.title: Cross Promo: Femboy Futa House Launch
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45103276/2a2e94fa2ffbd6086da255385f85ae9047a0ccc4.png[/img]

[b]My friends at Tophouse just released their new game, Femboy Futa House, on Steam![/b]

[b]Give it a try and support a cool group of devs making femboy games![/b]

[b]Story Overview:[/b]

Living at the College of Magical Arts won't be easy, but your power will help you ✨ After you fail your entrance exams, they send you to dorm 9 ¾ — home to the strangest and most extraordinary students on campus. But on your first night, something happens that changes everything: it turns out you have a rare gift — an Amplifier, the ability to amplify other people's magic. Now your life will be a whirlwind of attention, temptation and danger.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3602290/FEMBOY_FUTA_HOUSE/
